mission.title: Giving up Gotama
mission.description: Keep Zionite hunters off Halborn's trail as he searches for the Oracle.

npc.say:
It is unfortunate to find Carlyne in opposition to us, and supporting terrorists, but Halborn is by far the more unstable of the two. We do not believe that Carlyne will act against the System once Halborn is removed.
This situation relies very much upon human reactions, and that makes it difficult to control. I've given you this assignment because I know we can rely upon you, {player}.
Yeah, I'm sure it will work out all right. See you.

That smug idiot? Huh. He's pretty desperate if he's got these saps trying to do his dirty work.
Now, get out of here. When I want something from the Machines, you'll know.
We've all got to do what we've got to do... Isn't that right, {player}?
There is no chance to surprise the watchful.

phase.briefing:
Halborn is hunting for the Oracle, {player}. We attempted to locate her ourselves, but only stray code bits were found; these suggest that she is engaged in a coding project of some sort; the secrecy involved suggests that the project is of an...unlicensed nature.
Zionite interest in the Oracle, and Carlyne's feud with Halborn, complicate the scenario. They seek to prevent Halborn from reaching the Oracle. However, she represents Halborn's last significant hope for gaining the program he seeks. The sooner he obtains the program from her, or obtains confirmation that she does not have it, the sooner he is likely to leave the Matrix.
Agent Pace has additional support and information for you concerning this situation.

enter.say:
All right, Pace and some of our redpills are in there. No hostiles.
I'm not sure I followed everything Gray said, but it kind of sounds like they're okay with Halborn getting to the Oracle. Does that mean they think that he won't try to hurt her, or...that he will?

talk.say:
Ciao, {player}. Your current assignment is to eliminate Zionites pursuing Halborn. I am placing these two operatives under your command.
The Zionites are believed to be working with Carlyne. You should consider Carlyne hostile, and dangerous. If you see him, please report it immediately.

done.say: Those two won't be any help against Carlyne, that's for sure. Oh well, let's get 'em and get going.

objective.text: Lead Ferret and Brest out of the area

phase.briefing: Intercept Zionite hostiles at the indicated location, operative. They must be prevented from interfering with Halborn.

enter.say: I'm finding it easier if I just concentrate on the Zion-smashing aspect of this. Unregistered redpill programs in there are lighting up my screen. We've got 'em cold.

done.say: Not much chance of them catching Halborn now.

phase.briefing:
Halborn has been detected in the vicinity of the Mara neighborhood, where the Oracle is usually found.
We are unable to determine the Oracle's location at this time. Whether or not she has been concealed by hostile operatives is not known, but must be considered as a possibility. Their activity in that vicinity is high.
Carlyne is not detected in Mara, but if Zion finds Halborn there, they may call Carlyne for assistance. This must be prevented.

enter.say: Redpills in there... Hey, I'm getting heavy override readings, too.

talk.say: What the hell? Beat it. You'll just lead more of these annoyances to me. Does it look like I need your help?

done.say: Grr... This guy is really making it hard to want to help him...

near.say: Oh, joy. Look who it is.

phase.briefing:
Zion operatives continue to pursue Halborn, operative. If he does not locate the Oracle soon, the escalation of forces in that area will reach dangerous levels. We must also assume that Carlyne is by this time approaching the area as well.
Continue your elimination of the hostile forces. Halborn must remain free to reach the Oracle and conclude this affair.

enter.say:
This would be a whole lot easier if they could just send in Agents without having to worry that Carlyne would zap 'em. Hell, Halborn probably would, too, come to that.
Huh, this is weird... The wide scans picked up redpill activity, but I'm not reading anything in there now except standard background programs. Did the Zionites ditch out already?

talk.say:
All right, all right, I give up.
Haha. Miss me? Well, I'm sorry for the cloak and dagger routine, I really am, and I promise you, it's almost over. If all this fuss is over little old me, well... Maybe it'd be better for everyone if I was removed from the picture, huh?

done.say:
Ah, hell, who'm I kidding? I'm calling it in...
Seraph?! Where'd he-- Hang on...
Damn, and they won't send in programs. ... Jesus, they freaking put me on hold! Oracle there, hostiles closing in, and they put me on hold.
Look, you're just gonna have to come out and call Gray about it yourself. ... I know!

near.say:
What?! The Oracle? Uh...
So... So, {player}, do I call this in, or what?

mission.finish:
I am sure you can understand, operative, that arresting the Oracle at this time, in that area, is not...feasible.
Halborn's encounter with her, however, must be facilitated. This can best be accomplished by eliminating interference from hostile forces, and, in particular, by preventing contact between Halborn and Carlyne.
Halborn will be notified of this sighting as soon as possible. The...promptness of your report is appreciated, {player}. You may consider this assignment completed.
